English: Warrior Firepit
A rough ring of stones and logs, this firepit is where the first arrivals gather to tell tales, share warmth, and begin the forging of brotherhood among North Germanic berserkers.
Woolen Cloak Hut
A simple felted hut where the tribes first weavers gather, producing warm cloaks that keep nomads healthy and ready for the harsh northern climate.
Bearskin Pavilion
A large tent clad in bear pelts, used for gatherings of the bravest warriors. Its presence emboldens the tribe and helps the population weather the cold.
Drinking Circle
A reinforced enclosure for nightly feasts, boasting carved wooden benches and a central fire. Here, bonds are sealed and war songs echo, strengthening the unity and morale of the horde.
Initiates Lodge
A sturdy log longhouse where new warriors are tested and trained. Its construction marks the tribes transition from makeshift camps to a permanent martial tradition.
Test of Strength Ring
A fenced arena of trampled earth where competitors wrestle and duel for glory. Victories here inspire the horde and attract strong warriors to the tribe.
Berserker Hall
A grand mead hall built of heavy timber and stone, hung with trophies of past victories. Here the berserkers gather, strengthening their unity and readiness for war.
Oathkeepers Chamber
A fortified room within the hall where sacred oaths are sworn and ancient relics are kept. The chamber is a symbol of unity and trust, bolstering the loyalty and discipline of the horde.
Champions Den
A private lodge for the greatest berserker champions, decorated with weapons and banners. Their presence inspires loyalty, fear, and awe among the tribe and rivals alike.
Fury Lodge
An immense, fortified longhouse at the heart of the nomad host. The Fury Lodge is where berserkers are forged, and the tribes greatest councils held, ensuring unmatched horde unity and power.
